content: Firestore rules: request.auth != null only proves signed-in, not ownership (IDOR). Correct: request.auth.uid == resource.data.ownerId, plus request.resource.data.ownerId == request.auth.uid on create; split get/list/create/update/delete; rules are NOT filters so list queries must include owner constraint. No wildcard catch-all with allow read. Overlapping matches OR together. Admin SDK bypasses rules - so backend must enforce tenant/uid itself. Multi-tenant check via request.auth.token.firebase.tenant. Credential collections need explicit allow read,write if false.
